Name: Locked Crab Pots (SMAPI)
Author: ArcticPinou
Description:
[size=3]This mod prevent you from picking up crab pots if you're not holding the unlock key. LeftControl by default.[/size] (Configurable)

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]UnlockKey: The key to hold in order to pickup crab pots.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Extra info[/size][list]
[*]To uninstall delete Stardew Valley/Mods/LockedCrabPots.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: LockedCrabPot
Manifest.Description: Prevent picking up crab pots with only right click.
Manifest.Author: nini700
